sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict region_only: insert_after_residue 897 -> NULL; the paper names a region, not a junction (region: ECL4 at S898 in an isolated TMD2 fragment (junction 897|898 or 898|899 not stated)). validation_level surface_only -> detected_only (paper reports surface: no, function: not_reported). Paper (PMID 36609925): "The TMD2-3HA construct was generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR and a gene block consisting of triple HA, with 3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR.". Audit note: 'Positioned at position S898' does not say before/after/replacing S898, so the junction is 897|898 or 898|899 (or S898 replaced). More importantly TMD2-3HA is an isolated TMD2 domain fragment used only to test antibody specificity by immunoprecipitation of radiolabeled lysate; no full-length 3HA-CFTR and no surface assay exist in this paper, so validation_level surface_only is unsupported (should be detected_only at best).] L4 states '3xHA positioned at position S898 in ECL4 of CFTR' in a Gibson assembly construct of full-length CFTR. Python confirms seq[897]='S' (position 898) and seq[896]='H' (position 897); 'at position S898' means the tag is inserted before S898, i.e., insert_after_residue=897. Position 897 is 18 residues from TM7 end (879) and 21 residues from TM8 start (918). This is a distinct junction from the N901 FLAG site (L1/L2), 4 residues upstream in the same ECL4. L12 corroborates that HA tagging in this loop does not disrupt folding or trafficking. Full-length CFTR generated by Gibson assembly from pBI-CMV2-CFTR with a triple HA tag (3xHA) gene block positioned at S898 in ECL4, creating the TMD2-3HA construct. The paper names S898 as the position, which by standard insertion convention places the tag after residue 897 (H), immediately before S898.

sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the FLAG tag was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in the fourth extracellular loop of full-length CFTR. Python confirms seq[900]='N' and seq[901]='S', matching the paper exactly. Position 901 is 22 residues from TM7 end (879) and 17 residues from TM8 start (918), well clear of both TM boundaries. L2 and L3 independently corroborate the same junction in the same ECL4 of full-length membrane-anchored CFTR. Full-length CFTR (WT and F508del) expressed in CFBE cells from a doxycycline-inducible lentiviral vector; FLAG octapeptide (DYKDDDDK) inserted between Asn901 and Ser902 in ECL4 to create a traffic reporter construct (mCherry-Flag-CFTR). Construct showed significant surface expression after 24–48 h induction.

sources.claim: Additionally, a Flag sequence (DYKDDDDK) was inserted between Asn901 and Ser902, i.e., in the fourth extracellular loop of CFTR ( Fig. 1a–c ).

sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict confirmed_exact: insert_after_residue NULL -> 891: the paper pins the junction on human canonical P13569 (paper numbering: uniprot_canonical_human, construct species: human). Paper (PMID 37918963): "We investigated two potential positions for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of HiBiT in the ECL4 of WT-CFTR (Fig 1A) ... the effect of HiBiT tag insertion into two distinct sites in ECL4, either before (B38 clone) or after GLY sites (A22 clone), was evaluated. ... the HiBiT insertion before GLY sites in ECL4 did not disrupt WT-CFTR glycosylation, localization or function.". Audit note: Recoverable from Fig 2A and Table S1 (ssODN donors, Europe PMC supplementary): the crRNA3 donor (clone B38, before N894/N900) inserts GSGSGSGS-VSGWRLFKKIS-GSGSGSGS between D891 and K892 (TPLQD|KGNSTHSRNNSY), its homology arm ending at CDS nt 2673 = codon 891; the crRNA1 donor (clone A22, after the glycans) inserts between T910 and S911 (IITST|SSYYVF), right arm starting at codon 911. B38 is the validated clone (endogenous 16HBE14o- CFTR; extracellular HiBiT assay on live cells; Ussing-chamber forskolin/Inh172 currents), A22 showed an extra HiBiT-blot band and was dropped, so corrected_residue = 891; 910 is a second ECL4 site tolerated for surface expression. Both are new relative to the training rows at 897 and 901.] L7 reports CRISPR knock-in of HiBiT into ECL4 of full-length endogenous CFTR at two candidate positions, confirming the loop tolerates an 11-aa tag insertion and reaches the cell surface. No residue number is named in the clip, so the site is reported at region level (ECL4, residues 880–917) without a pinned junction. This is a third independent modality (CRISPR knock-in) confirming ECL4 tolerates extracellular tags. CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in of HiBiT into ECL4 of endogenous WT-CFTR at two candidate positions investigated for bioluminescence-based quantification of total and surface CFTR levels (lytic and extracellular assays). literature_notes: L2, L3, and L10 describe mCherry fused to the N-terminus of full-length CFTR. CFTR residue 1 is intracellular (topology landmark 1–77 = INTRACELLULAR); there is no signal peptide and no extracellular N-terminus. These clips therefore do not qualify as extracellular tag sites and were excluded. L11 and L12 describe a C-terminal GFP fusion on full-length CFTR; residue 1480 is intracellular (topology landmark 1148–1480 = INTRACELLULAR), so this is also excluded. L7 reports CRISPR/Cas9 HiBiT knock-in at 'two candidate positions' in ECL4 of endogenous CFTR but names neither position; this is region-level evidence only and does not add a new pinned site beyond those already established by L1 and L6. L8 and L9 describe HiBiT in the 'extracellular domain' of CFTR constructs 'as previously described', referencing the same prior literature as L1/L4; they provide additional support for the ECL4 region but name no new residue and therefore do not generate additional sites. ECL1 (94–124), ECL2 (219–222), ECL3 (325–347), ECL5 (1012), and ECL6 (1122–1126) are not supported by any qualifying ledger insertion and were not proposed.
